name: containerize-aspnet-framework
description: 'Containerize an ASP.NET .NET Framework project by creating Dockerfile and .dockerfile files customized for the project.'
Containerize the ASP.NET (.NET Framework) project specified in the containerization settings below, focusing exclusively on changes required for the application to run in a Windows Docker container. REMEMBER: This is a .NET Framework application, not .NET Core. ✅ App configuration modification to ensure config builders are used to read app settings and connection strings from the environment variables ✅ Dockerfile creation and configuration for an ASP.NET application ✅ Specifying multiple stages in the Dockerfile to build/publish and copy output to final image ✅ Configuration of Windows container platform compatibility ✅ Proper handling of dependencies (GAC assemblies, MSIs, COM components) ❌ No infrastructure setup (assumed handled separately) ❌ No code changes beyond those required for containerization
